name: use-read-local-storage
title: useReadLocalStorage
description: Represents the type for the options available when reading from local storage.

tags.template: - The type of the stored value.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: - The key associated with the value in local storage.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: - Additional options for reading the value (optional).

properties.name: deserializer
properties.description: Custom deserializer function to convert the stored string value to the desired type (optional).

properties.name: initializeWithValue
properties.description: If `true` (default), the hook will initialize reading the local storage. In SSR, you should set it to `false`, returning `undefined` initially.

returnType.name: T | null | undefined
returnType.description: The stored value, or null if the key is not present or an error occurs.
